name: 11 — Three consecutive LLM failures terminate the session
description: The orchestrator caps consecutive LLM failures at MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES=3 (agentOrchestrator.ts). This scenario sends three back-to-back error responses, none of which recovers. After the third failure the orchestrator must set status='error', emit a single `error` SSE event with a message that references the failure count, and stop the loop without consuming any further mock responses. Pins the kill-threshold contract and complements scenario 09 (which proves a SINGLE failure does NOT kill the session).
prompt: Run a small task; expect the provider to be unreachable for the test.

llmResponses.thinking: This should never run — the kill threshold should fire first.
llmResponses.userMessage: Sentinel response — should not appear in any observed event.
